description: Header file defining the UserPreferences class, which manages user settings and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations, class definitions, and interface mappings related to user preferences and notifications.

classes.name: UserPreferences
classes.description: Main class managing user preferences and notifications within the plugin framework, including initialization, deinitialization, and interface mapping.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing IUserSettings::INotification to handle user setting change notifications.

methods.name: getUILanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the UI language setting based on provided parameters.

methods.name: setUILanguage
methods.description: Sets the UI language based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ConvertToUserSettingsFormat
methods.description: Converts UI language string to user settings format.

methods.name: ConvertToUserPrefsFormat
methods.description: Converts presentation language string to user preferences format.

methods.name: PerformMigration
methods.description: Performs migration of user settings if needed.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the UserPreferences instance with the given shell.

methods.name: OnPresentationLanguageChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the presentation language.
